payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to address imbalanced datasets, including data expansion and loss control.

claims.text: One method to deal with imbalanced datasets is data expansion using oversampling, which includes duplicating texts with low pattern proportions and modifying characters.
Another method involves adding loss control in the model to help focus on harder cases in different classes, reducing the impact of imbalanced data.
The paper discusses various approaches to address the challenges posed by imbalanced datasets in the context of a hybrid text normalization system.
